structured_output.question: E000 shows the template is only a stub (accuracy 0.012, time 0.11 s), so the first real experiment has to put a full recipe in place, and the exact settings are still unknown. The search should answer this: which published from-scratch recipe reaches ≥75.3% CIFAR-100 top-1 test accuracy without test-time augmentation in the fewest epochs or least wall-clock time on one GPU? What does its accuracy-vs-epochs curve look like near 75% (needed for H1.1.1, H1.1.2 and H1.1.3), and how much do TTA, label smoothing (H1.3), lookahead/EMA (H4.2) and width (H1.5) each contribute? Exact hyperparameters are needed: widths, lr, wd, batch size, LS, whitening and epochs.
queries: fast CIFAR-100 training few epochs small ResNet
airbench CIFAR-10 speedrun patch whitening lookahead
94% on CIFAR-10 in 3.29 seconds single GPU

budgeted training CIFAR-100 epochs accuracy tradeoff

rubric: Reports CIFAR-100 (or CIFAR-10 with explicit transfer to CIFAR-100) top-1 test accuracy from scratch at <=~20 epochs or on a stated wall-clock budget on a single GPU
Gives enough hyperparameters to reproduce the recipe (architecture widths and depth, optimizer, lr, wd, batch size, label smoothing, schedule, epochs)
Reports accuracy without TTA, or isolates the TTA contribution, or gives ablations of label smoothing, lookahead/EMA, width or epoch count
Gives an accuracy-vs-epochs curve or variance across seeds near the 75% level
exclude: Methods using pretrained weights, transfer learning, distillation from pretrained teachers, or external/extra data
Results that depend on test-time augmentation or any use of the test set during training or tuning
Large-scale or multi-GPU/TPU training of ImageNet-sized models with no small-budget CIFAR results
Neural architecture search costing many GPU-hours to find the model
